ln:4463558574.descriptionHtml:
The Research Associate is a developing professional role. Deals with most problems independently and has some latitude to solve complex problems. Integrates in-depth specialty area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices. Good understanding of how the team and area integrate with others in accomplishing the objectives of the sub function/ job family. Applies analytical thinking and knowledge of data analysis tools and methodologies. Requires attention to detail when making judgments and recommendations based on the analysis of factual information. Typically deals with variable issues with potentially broader business impact. Applies professional judgment when interpreting data and results. Breaks down information in a systematic and communicable manner. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to exchange potentially complex/sensitive information. Moderate but direct impact through close contact with the businesses' core activities. Quality and timeliness of service provided will affect the effectiveness of own team and other closely related teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Reviews and processes broker votes to be shared and consumed
  • Organizes the product management team including creation of presentations, marketing schedules, coordination of the marketing diary, product planning meetings, diary management etc.
  • Publishes focus list notes, updating and displaying the new focus list posters etc.
  • Contributes to market data and subscriptions management for Equity Research
  • Responsible for collation, co-ordination and organization of Road Ahead conference, stock steering meetings
  • Assists with year-end scorecard preparation, result analysis, goals and training
  • Provides management information including variance analysis, month-end reporting etc.
  • Conducts expense management including travel and entertainment pre-approvals, client interaction spend pre-approval e.g. GLG, non-network individuals etc.
  • Manages and prepares Committee quality reviews
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:

  • MBA and/or CFA preferred
  • Existing knowledge of Research or external Investment research division essential
  • History of working within tight deadlines and prioritization
  • Microsoft systems especially Excel and Word
  • Ability to interact and manage at all levels ability to manage large amounts of data ability to use internal Citi systems would be an advantage but is not essential.
  • Accuracy and attention to detail
  • Secure and maintain applicable licenses

Education:

  • Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

------------------------------------------------------

Job Family Group:

Research

------------------------------------------------------

Job Family:

Research Analysis

------------------------------------------------------

Time Type:

Full time

------------------------------------------------------

Most Relevant Skills

Please see the requirements listed above.

------------------------------------------------------

Other Relevant Skills

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

------------------------------------------------------

Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.

View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster.

ln:4461724874.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4461039750.descriptionHtml:
IWPB Chief Operating Office (IWPB COO)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking, we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers look after their day-to-day finances and manage, protect and grow their wealth. The International Wealth and Premier Banking Chief Operating Office supports the business to deliver exceptional customer journeys and increase efficiency across our global network. We support the business through effective governance, financial and risk management, transformation, and operational management, ensuring that all International Wealth and Premier Banking business units and markets have the right capabilities and procedures to compete effectively and grow safely. We work in an agile manner and at pace, partnering with teams in Technology and Digital Business Services to bring innovative, digital-first solutions to our customers.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • 负责监督财富产品的日常交易、登记与结算操作及监管报表工作，确保其准确性与合规性
  • 在直线经理的指导下，担任团队内部项目的主要联系人，参与/协调团队成员完成项目实施和系统上线等安排
  • 确保监管报表报送的及时性、准确性、完整性、合规性。遵守各监管机构发布的相关统计及会计政策和条例。准确及时完成统计资料归档。
  • 通过实际工作经验积累以及培训或教育背景补充，具备在特定专业领域或职能方面扎实的能力。
  • 严格遵守集团的各项规章制度和合规政策，时刻保持对合规风险/操作风险的高度警惕，防范并降低该类风险的发生

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

所需知识：

  • 丰富的银行运营操作知识
  • 理财产品相关知识
  • 相关合规与监管要求

所需技能：

  • 问题解决能力
  • 能够激励团队士气，以应对在时间压力下高业务量的工作
  • 良好的英语听说读写能力
  • 优秀的沟通能力

主要挑战：

  • 在有限时间内处理多个复杂客户指令；
  • 协调团队成员，以达到高标准的服务质量和工作效率；
  • 在资源有限的情况下，承受工作压力并保持高效运作。

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist (AI Platform Full Stack Engineer).

Business: CTO Platforms

Job ID: 54313

Location：GZ/XA/SZ

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design and develop end-to-end platform features: frontend, backend, database, and cloud deployment.
  • Build modern web experiences using React + TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Develop and maintain backend services using Java and Python (APIs, integrations, platform services).
  • Implement data persistence and access patterns using GCP Cloud database services.
  • Deploy and operate services on GCP, including environment setup, CI/CD, monitoring, and incident support.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into applications (e.g., LLM/API integration, retrieval workflows, evaluation/monitoring).
  • Improve engineering quality through testing, code reviews, documentation, and performance tuning.
  • Collaborate with product, data, and engineering teams to deliver outcomes at pace.

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience with React in production.
  • Strong coding skills in TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Strong backend engineering experience with Java.
  • Strong backend/automation/integration experience with Python.
  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Cloud database services (e.g., Cloud SQL / Firestore / BigQuery / Spanner).
  • Experience taking software through the full lifecycle: design → build → deploy → operate.
  • Solid understanding of API design, security basics, and software engineering best practices.

/WX

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4455729236.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Associate Director, Business Analysis.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Own solution design for Credit platform capabilities across application, decisioning, simulation, and reporting.
  • Lead the Business Analysis practice within the Credit platform, embedding consistent standards, templates, and ways of working.
  • Partner with business and IT stakeholders across multiple countries to translate goals, priorities, and requirements into clear, actionable deliverables.
  • Act as the bridge between business, risk, operations, and engineering teams.
  • Represent Credit Technology in project working groups and governance forums, driving alignment, decisions, and timely delivery.
  • Create epics, user stories, business requirements, and functional specifications with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Produce functional designs for stories planned for development, including process flows, data mappings, business rules, and exception handling.
  • Support the Product Owner with backlog refinement, prioritisation, dependency management, and release planning.
  • Lead technical design reviews, architecture alignment, and delivery planning.
  • Drive integration with upstream and downstream systems, including trading, risk, finance, and data platforms.
  • Ensure quality through clear acceptance criteria, test strategy, QA support, and release governance.
  • Manage delivery risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communication.
  • Support regulatory, audit, and control requirements in solution design and rollout.

Requirements

  • Strong experience in credit domain platforms within banking or financial services.
  • Proven track record as a Tech Lead, BA Lead, or in a hybrid role within complex transformation programs.
  • 10+ years’ experience delivering IT change in Agile and/or hybrid delivery models.
  • Experience delivering projects in Wealth Management and/or Private Banking.
  • Strong domain knowledge across Credit, Wealth Financing, and Investments.
  • Hands-on understanding of enterprise architecture, APIs, event-driven integration, and data workflows.
  • Strong skills in requirements engineering, process modeling, stakeholder management, and impact assessment.
  • Experience delivering across the SDLC lifecycle in agile and controlled enterprise environments.
  • Fluent English communication skills, written and spoken.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • Proficient with delivery and documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Data analysis capability, including SQL, defining data requirements, and supporting data quality and reconciliation.
  • Ability to define and validate non-functional requirements, including performance, resilience, availability, observability, and scalability.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4485437794.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Develop and implement communications strategy and programs to continuously protect and promote the Bank's brand and bring to life the Bank's business strategy and core values via multiple external/internal touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Play a pivot role in developing and implementing communications strategy consistent with the Bank’s business strategies and priorities in China
  • Continuously build profile and uplift visibility for the bank in areas relating to Corporate & Investment Banking, Branding initiatives and Corporate Social Responsibilities

Business

  • Sound knowledge of the Bank’s global franchise, China market and a good understanding of the opportunities opening up for CIB business
  • Develop and implement strategic communications plan and roadmap, focusing on the Bank's strategy and business priorities
  • Focus on the following areas of CIB business from strategy to communications programmes & execution:
  • Coverage – Corporates & Financial Institutions
  • CIB Products – TB & FM
  • Initiatives such as China Opening-up, Chinese Enterprises Going Global, RMB Internationalisation, Belt & Road, Financial Connectivity Schemes, Sustainable and Transition Finance, Digitalisation
  • Executive profiling for senior executives' thought leadership in line with respective business focuses
  • Develop press releases, executive speeches, Op-Ed, WeChat articles and LinkedIn posts for corporate and business communications related programs
  • Arrange media interviews on proactive basis for major business developments/milestones and the Bank's focus areas
  • Lead media relations for China East region and provide communications support for reputational risk management for incidents in East

Risk Management

  • Adherence to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies (including anti-money laundering, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks) and the Group Code of Conduct
  • Work closely with media monitoring agency to be aware of related media voice on potential issues and provide sound judgement and mitigation plan from communications perspective
  • Play a key role in reputational risk management for the Bank, and work as a key CABM contact window for China East Region

Governance

  • Ensure adherence to the Risk Management Framework, Group Code of Conduct and various Policies, Procedures and Guidelines of the Bank by the Group and China CABM teams
  • Play a pivotal role in guiding relevant stakeholders on communications-related guidelines and best practices
  • Maintain high awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the business operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role
  • Completion of all mandatory training needed including e-learning within stated timeframes to support the understanding of the roles for delivering effective governance

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

Internal

  • China EXCO members
  • CIB China Head Office & CIB Business
  • East CGMs
  • China & Group CABM

External

  • Media
  • Communications counterparts at regulatory/ governmental authorities
  • Key financial analysts & opinion leaders
  • General public

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in CABM
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

Skills And Experience

  • Communications Strategy & Planning
  • Copywriting & Content Development
  • Media Engagement & Management
  • Reputational Risk Management
  • Strategic & Creative Thinking

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of communications experience, preferably with experience related to the financial services industry
  • Proven communications expertise, with the ability to develop and execute integrated communications strategies across earned, owned, and paid media channels
  • Strong writing, editing, and content development skills in both Chinese and English
  • Sound judgment and experience in issues and reputational risk management
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across businesses and functions
  • Strong self-motivation, strategic thinking, adaptability, and a high-level attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word and Outlook); familiarity with digital communications platforms, social media analytics and AI-enabled productivity tools is an advantage

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

ln:4485565240.descriptionHtml:
Description

Citi Research delivers industry-leading investment analysis to Citi’s global institutional investor and wealth management client base. Our team includes some 350 publishing analysts globally, with fundamental coverage of ~3,600 equity securities, as well as areas such as quantitative analysis, economics, fixed-income/rates/credit, FX, commodities, and data analytics. We also deliver access services such as conferences & events, corporate access & visits, and direct insights from market, policy, and industry experts.

Citi Research is seeking a Supervisory Analyst / Editor / Designated Quality Review Officer (DQRO) to join our nascent Shanghai-based Research office under Citigroup Securities (China) Co. Ltd. This is a role for a seasoned professional combining responsibilities in editorial, risk management, and operational processes. This role will primarily support and review research product produced by our new Shanghai team, both in English and Chinese. The role may also involve some review of global ex-PRC research product. The role requires strong editorial skills and financial/investment topics comprehension in order to filter, prioritize and validate potentially complex and dynamic material from multiple sources. Strong communication and diplomacy skills are required. Attention to detail is a must!

Key Responsibilities

  • Review investment research product to ensure compliance with PRC and US FINRA regulations, including reasonable basis and sourcing requirements.
  • Review investment research product to ensure compliance with Citi’s internal research content guidelines, as detailed in our research guidebooks and policies.
  • Edit investment research for quality, clarity, commerciality, style, and grammar.
  • Review both Chinese and English variants, including cross-checking consistency.
  • Review investment research language/tone and content for franchise risk, with consideration of the firm's reputation and business exposures, and in light of PRC and global political and client sensitivities. Be capable of editing to mitigate such risks (while maintaining our independent views), as well as determining when escalation is appropriate.
  • Handle the checking of investment research product for 1) issuer mentions for cross-checking against our Watch List; 2) the inclusion of appropriate disclaimers & disclosures; 3) data consistency; and 4) distribution tagging and other product & template elements.
  • Act as an editorial project manager, providing end-to-end traffic management of work-in-progress, liaising as needed with analyst teams, other Publications staff, product managers, control & compliance teams, data and technical support teams, and other relevant partners, to resolve problems and ensure product ultimately publishes. Additional managerial responsibilities may be assigned, given the need for flexibility in the small startup team.
  • Broadly as a Citi staffer, assess risk appropriately when business decisions are made, work in compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to policies, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


Qualifications

  • Have passed the examination uniformly organized by the CSRC for securities business personnel; Securities Association of China (SAC) test.
  • Holding a FINRA Series-16 license is a major advantage. We may also consider strong candidates without Series-16 and would sponsor them to sit the exam, including providing study materials. Quick study prep time and then successfully passing this challenging exam is a requirement for the role.
  • Candidate should have at least five years of experience creating, supporting, or editing investment/financial analytic content. Candidate should be a fluent Chinese and English speaker with evidence of editorial and writing capability.
  • We expect candidates to have strong familiarity with financial markets, financial terminology, and ongoing business news in PRC, Asia, and globally.
  • Ability to prioritize and to juggle multiple tasks simultaneously amid tight deadlines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to exercise sound and balanced judgment.
  • Meticulous and detail oriented. Key aspects of the role involve being able to remember and apply many guidelines and procedures on a consistent and reliable basis.
  • Team members should have comfort working with sometimes complex publishing software platforms (e.g. Sinitek) and ability to coordinate with partner teams when trouble-shooting technical issues.
  • Team player with good interpersonal skills, and the patience and diplomacy to work with demanding internal customers and effectively find win-win solutions.


This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

|CSTC|HQCT|C13|YIN|GLN|LP|WY

Other Key Requirements

  • Bachelor’s undergraduate university degree or higher
  • PRC nationality
  • Have complete civil capacity; be of good moral character, fair-minded and honest, and possess sound professional ethics.
  • Have not incurred any criminal penalty or any serious administrative penalty related to securities or futures business.


Job Family Group

Research

Job Family

Research Product

Time Type

Full time

Please see the requirements listed above.

Other Relevant Skills

For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter.

Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review Accessibility at Citi.

ln:4486925269.descriptionHtml:
• Citibank China Company Ltd. (‘CCCL’) is Citibank’s locally incorporated subsidiary with full-fledged banking license serving the Mainland China market. Second Line of Defense (‘2LoD’) oversight for Liquidity Risk, Non-Trading Market Risk (Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book - IRRBB), and Balance Sheet Risks is executed by Finance CRO (FinCRO).
  • The Treasury Risk Vice President (C13) leads independent 2LoD oversight, risk limit framework design/recalibration, quantitative risk analysis, and credible challenge for Non-Trading Market Risk and Liquidity Risk across CCCL.
  • The role ensures robust governance across risk appetite, intraday liquidity, internal/regulatory liquidity stress testing, IRRBB supervisory frameworks (including Supervisory Outlier Tests), behavioral modeling assumptions, and regulatory compliance with PBOC/NFRA and Basel standards.

Job Background / Context

CCCL’s Independent Risk Management acts as the second line of defense for the holistic management of risk across all business lines and entities in China. Within Independent Risk Management, the Finance CRO team provides independent oversight, review, and credible challenge to 1LoD functions (Corporate Treasury, Market Treasury, and Global Markets).

The team ensures CCCL maintains an adequate liquidity profile, resilient intraday payment/settlement capacity, and an optimized balance sheet structure that operates strictly within Board-approved Risk Appetite thresholds for Liquidity, IRRBB, Capital Adequacy, and Investments. The VP serves as a senior subject matter expert driving quantitative risk analytics, limit calibrations, and regulatory engagements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Risk Limit Setting, Calibration & Risk Appetite Framework
  • Limit Setting & Recalibration: Lead the periodic and ad-hoc review, establishment, and quantitative recalibration of CCCL’s Treasury Risk Limit Framework covering Liquidity, IRRBB, and balance sheet structure.
  • Risk Appetite & Triggers: Formulate and recalibrate Board-approved Risk Appetite Statements (RAS), Early Warning Indicators (EWIs), and management triggers to reflect balance sheet changes, business strategy, and market dynamics.
  • Methodology Challenge: Provide formal 2LoD challenge on underlying limit methodologies, allocation waterfalls, buffer sizing, and scenario severity parameters.
  • Liquidity Risk Management & Intraday Liquidity Oversight
  • Intraday Liquidity Oversight: Drive 2LoD monitoring and independent oversight of intraday liquidity risk, time-critical payment/clearing obligations (CNAPS/CIPS), and intraday collateral mobilization.
  • Payment Buffer & Collateral Adequacy: Assess and challenge CCCL’s intraday liquidity buffers, credit lines, central bank pledged collateral, and overdraft facilities under normal and stressed conditions.
  • Contingency Funding Planning (CFP): Review and challenge the operational feasibility of CCCL’s Contingency Funding Plan, liquidity escalation triggers, and asset monetization capabilities.
  • Liquidity Stress Testing (LST) & Scenario Modeling
  • Internal Stress Testing (ILST): Lead 2LoD review and credible challenge of CCCL’s Internal Liquidity Stress Testing frameworks, Resolution Liquidity Adequacy (RLAP/RLEN), and survival horizon metrics.
